title: Sparse Autoencoder Feature Consistency Across Random Seeds
original_idea: Train five SAEs on identical data (GPT-2 Small layer 8) with different random seeds. Compute pairwise feature matching by cosine similarity of weight vectors. Report distribution of best-match similarities and fraction with near-duplicates (>0.9).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests reproducibility, a minimum bar for trustworthy safety audits. If features change with seeds, interpretability findings are unreliable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: SAELens handles SAE training. Five small training runs on GPT-2 Small layer 8 are lightweight. Cosine similarity matching is simple. Well within 30hrs.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Extremely narrow: one layer, five seeds, pairwise cosine similarity, one threshold (0.9). Clear histogram deliverable.
